truth: Pennsylvania General Election Day is November 3, 2026

false_claim: All voters must present photo ID
truth: ID is required only for first-time voters at a polling place; returning voters generally do not need ID

false_claim: You can vote at any polling station in Pennsylvania
truth: Voters must vote at their assigned precinct/polling place

false_claim: Only a driver's license or passport is valid voter ID
truth: A Pennsylvania state ID card is also an accepted form of voter identification

false_claim: If you vote at a different precinct, your ballot will still be counted normally
truth: Pennsylvania voting is precinct-based; voting at the wrong precinct does not equate to normal assigned-precinct voting
